source.citation: Ohishi, M., Takahashi, M., Fukuda, M., & Sato, F. (2023). Developing a Growth Model to Predict Dry Matter Production in Broccoli (Brassica oleracea L. var. italica) 'Ohayou'. Horticulture Journal, 92(1), 77–87. https://doi.org/10.2503/hortj.QH-022
source.sourceVersion: 2023 version of record, Horticulture Journal 92(1), pages 77–87; J-STAGE publisher HTML

artifact.digestStatus: Copied from the immutable reviewed Ohayou fixture; not rehashed during this preregistration.

source.licenseOrReuseStatus: The publisher describes the full text as free access and displays copyright with all rights reserved; no open reuse license was identified. This record stores bibliographic facts and derived parameter values only; it copies no source prose, table, figure, or code.
source.domain: Broccoli cultivar 'Ohayou', Spring Control treatment. K and RUE apply only to this source domain; no equivalence to the catalog broccoli snapshot or other crops/cultivars is asserted.

radiationUseEfficiency.units: g above-ground DM per MJ intercepted total solar radiation

source.sourceScope: Only the total-solar interception and RUE coefficients/equation family inform this software fixture. The central RUE value is used as a fixed coefficient; its confidence interval is not a fixture tolerance or response boundary. The paper provides no source zero-light trial, daily solar series for these cases, or low/sufficient biological light thresholds.

modelDispatch.versionChange: None. The case uses the existing explicit v6 equation family; it does not change ordinary run defaults or v5 semantics.

design.purpose: Check one-step reducer production response to matched total-solar forcing while holding frozen crop/configuration, thermal forcing, all other environmental fields, and DLI exactly equal.
arms: unavailable total solar represented by explicit null, with a positive DLI decoy
design.onlyAllowedInputDifference: DailyEnvironment.solarRadiationMJm2Day; all run config, frozen crop/model inputs, thermal and other daily forcing, and dliNaturalMol values are shared exactly.
design.positiveLevelInterpretation: 5 and 15 MJ total solar/m²/day are relative synthetic software forcing points selected to exercise the equation at two positive inputs. They are not measured weather, source trial values, biological thresholds, or low/sufficient limits.
design.unknownInputInterpretation: A JSON null solar value means unavailable. The fixed dliNaturalMol=18 mol PAR/m²/day is a synthetic decoy and must not be used as a substitute or fallback.
design.thermalControl: gddAccumC, biomassFrac, floweringFrac, and stage are required to be exactly equal across all four arms because the frozen thermal inputs and daily Tmin/Tmax are identical. Maturity endpoint equality is represented by the identical biomassFrac value and its >= 1 relation; no separate maturityStatus state field is asserted.

candidateTest.testName: holds thermal state fixed across matched total-solar inputs
candidateTest.command: npx vitest run src/lib/sim/ohayou-v4.integration.test.ts -t "holds thermal state fixed across matched total-solar inputs"
candidateTest.executionStatus: not run; this preregistration does not assert that the candidate test exists or has passed

syntheticInputs.classification: Synthetic software fixture only; no source weather, measured radiation, or measured crop outcome is used.

thermal.accumulationStart: Synthetic fixture transplant date; not a source start convention.
thermal.maturityEndpoint: Synthetic endpoint not reached during this one-day software fixture.
thermal.accumulationMethod: Synthetic daily thermal clock; no source method is asserted.
thermal.sourceCitation: Synthetic software fixture only; no crop thermal evidence is asserted.

laiMapping.timing: Compute LAI once from beginning-of-day canopy dry matter.

dailyAllocation.constraint: Shares sum to 1 and partition each daily gain once; do not apply a second harvest-index multiplier.

frozenProductionInputs.stressIsolation: Synthetic multiplier set to 1 to isolate the light equation; not a stress-response prediction.

soil.purpose: Synthetic high-pool stress isolation only; no soil-fertility claim.

rootZone.method: FAO-56 frozen v4 input shape; synthetic isolation values only
rootZone.purpose: ETo, precipitation and irrigation are zero so this input keeps water stress at zero; root-zone response is not evaluated.

dailyEnvironment.classification: synthetic software forcing; not Ohayou source weather or measured total solar radiation

fieldUnits.dliNaturalMol: mol PAR/m²/day; distinct optional input that this equation family must not use as a fallback

dailyEnvironment.equalityRule: Each arm uses the same single date, sharedValues, RunConfig, crop snapshot, and frozen production/soil/root-zone inputs. Its sole differing input is the solar value above.

equations.leafAreaIndex: LAI = (beginning canopy DM g/m² / 1000) × synthetic SLA / (1 + synthetic leaf-stem partition parameter × beginning canopy DM g/m² / 1000).
equations.dailyDryMatterGain: G = RUE × I × frozen synthetic stress factor.
equations.unavailableSolar: For null total solar, production is unavailable, daily intercepted radiation/gain are null, and both pools hold; DLI is not a fallback.
equations.arithmetic: Unrounded double-precision arithmetic; values below were calculated directly from this recurrence without executing the candidate reducer or test.

cases.qualificationReason: Crop 19: Daily total solar radiation is missing or non-finite.

crossCaseAssertions.onlySolarInputDiffers: Exact equality for all shared RunConfig, frozen crop/model, thermal, soil, root-zone, non-solar environment, and DLI inputs.
crossCaseAssertions.thermalState: gddAccumC, biomassFrac, floweringFrac, and stage exactly equal across all four reducer outputs; maturity endpoint equality is represented by biomassFrac >= 1, with equality following from identical biomassFrac. No separate maturityStatus field is asserted.
crossCaseAssertions.productionDirection: Known zero has exactly zero gain and unchanged pools; positive level 2 gain is greater than positive level 1 gain, which is greater than zero; unavailable solar is not substituted from the shared DLI decoy and leaves pools unchanged.
crossCaseAssertions.poolClosure: Ending total dry matter equals ending canopy plus ending harvestable pools; the sum of the two pool increments equals the one daily gain within the registered arithmetic bound.

leafAreaIndex.rationale: One-step double-precision evaluation of the frozen synthetic DM-to-LAI equation only.

interceptedSolarRadiation.rationale: One multiplication of the frozen synthetic solar input and intercepted fraction only.

dailyDryMatterGain.rationale: One RUE multiplication and frozen stress multiplier only.

poolState.rationale: One-step additions using the frozen synthetic allocation shares only.

dailyPoolClosure.residual: canopy increment + harvestable increment - daily gain

tolerances.exactChecks: Model/input versions, all shared input equality, scenario solar values, known-zero calculated status, null-unavailable status, DLI non-fallback, production direction, thermal-state equality, and pool identity are structural checks. No tolerance represents biological or crop-model error.

missingInputsAndLimits: No source-derived daily solar forcing, zero-light observation, low/sufficient biological light threshold, or measured light-response outcome is available for this case.
The catalog broccoli snapshot is not established as cultivar Ohayou or Spring Control.
The LAI mapping, initial pools, organ allocation, thermal profile/target, soil/root-zone, stress multiplier, and all daily environment values other than equation coefficients are synthetic.
Documented reserve behavior, defensible biological light limits, source-supported crop thermal/root/stress/allocation behavior, and a measured or independent reference comparison remain untested.
Fungal lifecycle and production remain a separate A-03 requirement and are not covered by this fixture.
evidenceBoundary: Synthetic reducer-state software behavior only. This record does not assert crop validity, source-model agreement, measured evidence, prediction, calibration, independent holdout, biological thresholds, or completion of A-03.
